backend/main.mo: Motoko canister with access-controlled user profiles and product creation plus metadata retrieval using maps and authorization mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product‑related features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing short descriptions of many frontend modules including utilities, editors, generation logic, and UI components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme setup defining light and dark CSS variables and applying shared border/background styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading JS bundle and CDN versions of jsPDF and JSZip.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app coordinating authentication, onboarding, view switching, and product workspace flow.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with aria labels and fallback handling for auth edge cases.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for entering and saving the user’s name during initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: React error boundary showing a styled fallback UI with reload option and dev-only error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: UI component displaying multi-tab usage and selling instructions for editing, generating, and exporting products. Includes step-by-step guides for app usage, Gumroad, and Etsy.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Export screen that lists generated bundles and provides PDF, ZIP, and master ZIP download actions with error handling. Includes file size formatting and navigation back to the editor.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with header navigation, authentication-aware actions, and buttons for instructions, export, preview, and storefront. Wraps page content and manages top-level UI state.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal that shows onboarding instructions using ExportInstructions inside a dialog. Provides a dismiss button to close and begin using the app.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: PDF preview panel that displays an iframe preview for a generated PDF or an alert if none exists. Manages blob URL lifecycle for previewing.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Unified preview screen showing product cards with cover images, descriptions, and PDF previews per product. Allows expanding descriptions and navigating back.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Displays a file list preview of what will be included in a product's ZIP download. Dynamically lists templates, checklists, and prompts with icons.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: UI editor for modifying a product’s fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with add/update/remove actions and a generate trigger.
Manages a list of products, draft persistence, active product selection, and single or bulk generation with error handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover image, expandable description, and an edit button for storefront views.
Renders a storefront grid of default products with navigation back to the editor and edit-product actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity, auto-refreshing queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity login, persistence, and status handling via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Tracks whether onboarding instructions have been seen and controls auto‑open or manual opening of the modal.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query wrappers for fetching and saving the caller’s user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light/dark modes plus utility classes and workspace styling.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Defines product cover image paths and utilities to fetch them as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Provides default product definitions with modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utility functions to trigger browser downloads for blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-stamped filenames for PDFs and ZIP files.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Generates bundles for multiple products sequentially with optional progress reporting.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a complete product bundle by generating the PDF and ZIP with error handling.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages loading, saving, and resetting product drafts in localStorage with versioning.
Creates a PDF guide for a product using jsPDF, including cover, description, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing all product ZIPs plus a combined README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Creates a ZIP for a single product including PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Provides reusable README content sections for product ZIPs, including usage and marketplace upload guides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with query client and identity provider.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear stored or hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature lists, issues, and new feature requests for the Product Bundle Studio state tracking.
